$comment: Rules for scripts/build-skills.mjs. Values on the page are for an unequipped character with no points in other skills; 'stats' sets the stat('…'.accr) values that are not 0 on such a character, and 'baseSkills' are the skills every character has at level 1.
pageNotes: Values assume no items and no points in other skills. Bonuses from synergies are listed under each skill and are not included in the numbers.
Pick a skill level and character level to see the values the game would show. Some skills scale with character level as well as skill level.

tokenAliases.$comment: Formula tokens: a string renames a token (fixes typos in the data), a number pins its value.
